notes.title: 【重大更新】Teamtower Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Content update

 UI redo is officially released.
 Adjusted the main screen page for entering the game, now all interfaces that can be clicked on are shown independently and visually.
The professions in the tavern are displayed independently, with the behavior of the professions displayed independently in the profession icons, and new space for text and profession stories.
 We have made a pre-evaluation of the "difficulty" of each profession and displayed it as a "profession rating".
 Optimized the enhancement purchase screen.
Optimized the in-game character display logic and added a "marker system" to make it easier for players to distinguish between team members of the same profession who have different behaviors.
Optimized the corresponding team switching, team display, and member selection interface.
Optimized the in-game store interface to make it more concise and intuitive.
 Optimized the library page.
 Optimized the event room display to make it more beautiful.
 Reset the ui interface to make it display more flat.
 Added some dynamic effects to the buttons.
 Optimized the way the game works.
 Optimized the game's battle logic.
Added hint descriptions to the Library and Pray page, explaining the detailed functions of the corresponding icons.
Optimized the speed of appearance of the battle settlement page to make the pacing more reasonable.
Optimized the description of the "Devour" card to make it more intuitive.
Fixed the text display of the number of skill removals in the Library, which now synchronizes the remaining count with the player's skill removal.
Changed the display priority level of teams so that characters currently in use are displayed first.
Optimized the trigger logic of "Support Strike" to only trigger it when there are enemies on the field.
Add character's story


After the game was launched, we collected some comments and feedback from our partners. We took this very seriously and conducted a round of internal evaluation, and finally decided to adjust and enrich several aspects, including character balance, story text enrichment, ui adjustment, etc. Now the announcement is a summary of all the optimizations we made recently.
Now, these optimizations have officially come to an end, so this announcement is a summary of all the optimizations we've made recently.
The current version is now complete with testing, and we will continue to optimize it. We welcome comments from players and the community, and we hope you will continue to support TeamTower!

notes.title: October Update @10.14.2021
notes.notes:
Since the last September, we have reevaluated and reconsidered the difficulty rating, as well as the balance between characters. In the end we decided to redo most of the skills and smooth out the existing difficulty curve. We have also added more mechanics to help you understand the depth of the game and better control your character.

Here are the updates.

Character adjustments
[olist]
 Most of the characters' skills have been remade (we strongly recommend you to try the previously unused support characters, they are now powerful enough)
 The probability of getting a new [ team member ] after the battle is no longer related to food, as long as your team is not filled up, then you can pick a new team member after the battle
 Players now take behaviors from all rarities for each slot in the [Ancient Library]
[/olist]

World Difficulty (difficulty increase and time crystal acquisition) adjustment
[olist]
 [World Difficulty] advancement will no longer jump levels (this means you can only advance up to one level of difficulty per game, which effectively prevents a large gap in the experience between two games)
 drastically cut the strength of monsters in low difficulty, now relying on the game of luck less than before.
 smoothed out the values between the various levels of difficulty. 
 appropriately increased the number of [Time Crystals] obtained at lower [World Difficulty] (and the number of [Time Crystals] obtained by resetting at higher levels has become smaller, which means that the distribution of [Time Crystals] will become more important)
[/olist]

Other game system adjustments
[olist]
 players can now specify [priority target] for most [single attack] actions by clicking on the monster ( please note that you cannot specify a non-taunting monster as a priority target if the monster has taunts )
 [Attribute] selection is no longer related to the monster's experience, but is gained with [number of battles]. Now players will get a chance to select [Attribute] for every 3 battles they go through.
[/olist]

Future update preview
The next period of time we will focus on optimizing the game interface, including the unification of interface design and style, as well as the animation performance of the interface, these tasks may take more time.

notes.title: Monday Update@2021.9.13
notes.notes:
Fix bugs

Fix the problem that "Apply Poison" and "Severe pain" can cause abnormal accumulation of toxins under certain circumstances
Fix some text errors



The following updates are for the Windows version only

TeamTower is now running in administrator mode (we used a registry repair to try to fix the recurring black screen problem that occurs in some players, we hope it works)
If you still encounter the black screen problem and Steam does not run TeamTower in administrator mode, please right click TeamTower, select "Manage - Browse Local Files", find "TeamTower.exe", right click "Properties" - "Compatibility" check "Run as administrator" (the above applies to Win10, if it does not match the description, please check how to run the program as administrator on your computer) Run the program)
After completing the above and running TeamTower, if you are still having black screen problems, be sure to contact us!


Resource Updates

The following updates are for the Windows version only(Mac will be later)

Overly enlarged the character details prompt icon on the character selection screen (a magnifying glass, which we noticed many players would ignore) to try to avoid the problem that some players tend to ignore the icon and the function



Balance
Monster balance adjustment
FIrst floor


Beam Sweep: Deals 100→90 points of damage to all team members.
Chaos Restoration: Clears itself debuff, increasing attack by 60→30 points.
We think it gets too powerful a bonus to the point that it can easily destroy squads through skill regiments in the late game.


Second Floor

Curse Power: Increases a monster's attack by 60→30 points.
Rising Rage: All monsters' attack  is increased by 40→20 points.
Heat Blast: Deals 150→90 points of damage to a team member and adds 3 stacks of Iginite.
Super Electricshock: Deals 80→70 damage to all enemies.
These monsters exert too much pressure on the players, so we decided to make some adjustments and nerfs to them


Third Floor
Claw Strike: Deals 40→30 points of damage to a team member 3 times.
Her temper is a little better now.

Gain Power(Normal Type): Increase 60→40 attack."
Gain Power(Mutant Type): Increase 60→30 attack.
Their behavior can lead to excessive output caused in a single turn, so this has been adjusted.


Evil Force: All monsters gain 70→45 points of attack bonus.
Too frequent use of power has led to a weakening of the power of the evil gods that they can receive.

notes.title: Timtal - EA Release and Troubleshooting
notes.notes:
Now, our sneak preview version is officially available on Steam.

Team Tower is the answer to our quest to develop a deck-building game. We wanted a new way to build "decks" and "deck building" gameplay without compromising the fun and enjoyment that players would otherwise have in such games.
This has been a long and difficult process, and we care about and value our players' experience, so we chose to release the game as EA to get your feedback.
If you have any questions or bug reports, please let us know and we will reply as soon as possible to improve the game experience.

You can leave a message in this announcement or in the comment section of the game to tell us anything about your playing experience or feedback, and you are also welcome to join our player community through QQ group or Discord to communicate more conveniently in it.

QQ：661911874
Discord: https://discord.gg/qB8yp7BZ

Thank you for playing our game!
